scope: Installed declarations and immutable CPU library identities only; native behavior remains unmeasured by this audit.

declarations.contract: Contains a list of scalar outputs. Declares no-argument, one unnamed integer, and two unnamed integer constructors; the argument meaning is unspecified in the installed stub.
Exposes a std_vector_int container. Its current storage must be observed before relying on a scalar getter.
Getter returns only when exactly one scalar is stored, otherwise throws. A setter taking an integer is declared; the stub does not describe whether it changes storage size.
Declares len, indexed get/set, iteration and resize(n) plus resize(n,value), sufficient to explicitly establish one-element storage and inspect coherence.

Getter returns an integer; setter accepts int_output. Described as an optional output counter of skipped faces. Lifetime, pointer aliasing and overwrite-versus-increment behavior are not established by these declarations.
On input identifies faces to add, on output the faces that failed to be added; exact output still requires the single admitted runtime observation.
Accepts faces, vertices, BuildSettings and duplicateNonManifoldVertices defaulting True. The frozen probe must explicitly set False, allowNonManifoldEdge=True and shiftFaceId=0.

microproof_review: Record actual bounded storage/getter behavior for the five frozen helper-constructor forms without assigning meaning to unnamed arguments.
Explicit length-zero and length-two controls must demonstrate getter rejection. The chosen no-argument holder must be resized to exactly one element and show scalar/storage coherence.
Bind only the single-element holder. Keep it alive, mutate its existing scalar in place, and require the settings getter to track the changed nonzero sentinel. Never resize after binding.

Only after all preconditions pass may the one frozen 3-vertex/1-face constructor run with that same live holder. Require an observed sentinel-to-zero result, empty failed region, dense valid IDs and exact oriented fixture readback.

The sentinel-to-zero gate is an empirical overwrite qualification, not a source-guaranteed API behavior. Unchanged/ambiguous accumulation requires BLOCKED and preserved evidence, with no zero-initialised retry or alternate constructor.
limits: This source audit does not qualify any native helper behavior, geometry transport, sheet pairing, remesher, real patch, target generation or appearance transfer.
Static library pins retain the earlier PE declaration-only limitation: dynamic plugin/LoadLibrary and driver activity were not measured.
